title: Sharing my FREE TO PLAY fanmade pokemon game
author: Fresh_Mud4203
selftext:
[dexora-self.vercel.app](http://dexora-self.vercel.app) is Inspired by Deluge RPG, focused on pokedex completion with different pokemon variants and events with trading, battles and card ripping and collecting

💥The game also has live battles see video sample below!

Would love you guys to try it out and here feedbacks!

replies.author: Voiston44
replies.body:
Dev: Hey Claude, add a little juice to the Ember animation in my Pokémon battle.

Claude: Done! Added a soft orange glow to the little flame, two floating spark particles on impact, and a gentle floating "-3 HP" text popup. Looks very cute and clean!

Dev: No Claude. Add more juice.

Claude: Understood. Added real-time heat distortion shaders to the fireball, dynamic flickering shadows across the grass, a snappy 60ms hitstop, and a crackling bonfire audio loop with heavy bass on impact.

Dev: Claude. MORE. I want the player to feel the heat radiating off their monitor !

Claude: Upgraded. The fireball now spawns 800,000 ray-traced volumetric embers that cast dynamic shadows on the HUD itself. Time slows to 5% for cinematic gravity, the camera violently clips into the opponent's panicked face, and the impact bass is mixed so hot it automatically trips your Discord noise gate.

Dev: MORE! I WANT THE HARDWARE ITSELF TO SUFFER!

Claude: Done. Each Ember cast now has an intentional memory leak for authentic frame-pacing tension, alongside an estimated 20% chance to trigger a micro-voltage drop across your motherboard’s RAM channels. The screen shake permanently displaced your desktop icons 3 centimeters to the left, and the engine flashes a Windows Blue Screen for two frames purely as a stylistic impact transition.

Dev : Perfect. Do you think I need to add an epilepsy warning?
